headline: Incredible what's happening with loans. ZBP: a record
summary: Polish banks granted over 242,000 housing loans worth more than PLN 115bn in the first three quarters of 2026, exceeding all of last year's sales. The Polish Banking Association said lenders have tightened lending criteria.
why: Mortgage lending is a key driver of Poland's housing market and bank earnings. Tighter lending standards affect credit growth and the banking sector's risk profile.
original_headline: Niesamowite, co się dzieje w kredytach. ZBP: rekord
